'''Ghery Pettit''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 105 from Olympia, Wa. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He began playing in Olympia, Washington in summer 1997.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
